summary: Phase 3 testing — 4 tasks validated: partner-application endpoint, pricing EN-US seed, about page placeholder filter, DesignJourneyTeaser injection. All core functionality works. One minor locale issue noted.

integration_issues.issue: Page shows English copy ('Become a partner') even when accessed via Italian slug /candidatura-partner. The locale is determined by LocaleContext (user setting), not by URL slug. This is expected architecture behavior but may confuse users accessing the IT URL directly.

Homepage hero shows Italian content but DesignJourneyTeaser shows 'COMING SOON' (EN) instead of 'PROSSIMAMENTE' (IT). Same root cause: LocaleContext default may differ between render cycles or initial state is 'en-US'.

action_items: LOW: Investigate LocaleContext initial state — if default locale should be 'it-IT', the teaser and partner page should show Italian copy on first load without user switching locale.
critical_code_review_comments: SectionRenderer.jsx hasPlaceholder() only checks one level deep (Object.values), nested placeholder strings in sub-objects would not be filtered. Current about page data appears to have flat structure so works correctly.
PartnerApplicationForm: profile_type is required in Pydantic but submit button is disabled if !form.profile_type — correct UX guard in place.
Migration 037 uses gen_random_uuid() (UUID v4) without ::text cast while contact_submissions uses gen_random_uuid()::text — inconsistency but both work since partner_applications.id is UUID type.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (minor locale issue, all core flows work)

seed_data_creation: Test records created in partner_applications table via POST tests (TEST_ prefixed emails)
